data.textDisplay: I have been using this eye cream ever since you posted this video, and I love it!  As a bonus, it does not irritate my eyes, and almost every eye cream makes my eyes water.  This one does not.  Thank you!

Honestly my skin has improved tons since I’ve been watching Dr. Dray. she’s right about eye creams, totally unnecessary but can add that little extra hydration. I personally use the Eucerin Q-10 anti wrinkle cream as an eye & neck cream and it’s served me well 🤷🏻‍♀️
Price increase $4 from September to December. $6 more than the basic product

When derms say “you don’t need a separate eye cream” they are excluding an entire skin type. Women who have typically oily skin (therefore use a moisturizer that is geared to oily skin)…but ALSO are dealing with aging DO absolutely need an eye cream separate from their normal daily moisturizer. This is very simply because the delicate skin under the eyes is ABSOLUTELY NOTHING like the texture of generally oily face skin. Delicate and aging eye skin is a completely different  and cannot be treated with the same products you bought because your skin is oily. To me this is fairly obvious. I really wish professionals would stop with the idea that no one needs an eye cream. This is absolutely not true. As a woman with oily skin at every age…who also deals with aging skin…I really like this particular eye cream Dr. Dray is speaking of. I’ve been using it and I love it.

I went to my dermatologist on Monday for my checkup for Vasculitis on my legs. My legs are doing great. So we started talking about my face skin. First off he said my skin is incredible! He ask what my routine was for morning and night. (I told him I watch Dr. Dray) he was happy Because he said anyway people find out you must where sunscreen every day is a good thing! 😊
We decided I could add Tretinoin to my skin care routine. I am soooo excited to start Tretinoin. I have use adapalene for 2 years. And he said that it has prep my skin for tretinoin. He thinks I will ease into Tretinoin. 
Thank you Dr Dray for all you do for us!

I use this twice a day. It makes my eyes feel very hydrated and never greasy. Makeup goes on very well over it. I like that it also has petrolatum in it. At night I mix a drop of squalane with it. Very silky and luxurious. Thanks for your review, Dr Dray. All your details are much appreciated! I use several CeraVe products daily. All excellent!
"i am a cerave STAN" - what a mood hahahah
Dr Dray. I'm your first watcher of this video from Afghanistan.
I totally agree with you on the eye repair cream. I was very disappointed in it for all the same reasons you stated.
I love that you are dabbling on eye makeup too Dr. Dray.

I will def try this product.  Love Cerave products.  I cannot use my face moisturizer on my eyes - my eyes are super sensitive.  I have used Clinique All About Eyes Rich because this is the only product that I found that would not irritate my eyes.  Thanks for all of your videos.
I have used Cerave Eye Repair Cream, and I agree with everything you said about it;  I would not rush to repurchase.  I will, however, give the new peptide eye cream a go now.
I spotted this in target a few weeks ago and considered getting it because I love their original eye cream.  I decided to wait for your review on it lol!😅 I’ll go get it now! Thanks! 😁

I've been using this for a month or two now and I like it; I used the Eye Repair for a long time before that and liked that one too, but I think this one has a bit more oomph. I agree that separate eye creams are unnecessary, but I really like the tiny squeeze applicator (and price point).

I have translucent skin around my eyes like my grandma. Top and bottom. Nothing can cure that but I like making sure I'm hydrating them, I'm currently using my facial serums and moisturizers on them it's softened the skin greatly. (Thank goodness for concealer because without it I look ill. No "natural beauty" option like 2 of my sister's can , because they have great skin!).

Yes we need a seperate eye cream, I used your beloved Neutrogena hydra boost gel cream fragrance free under my eyes, I woke up with burned and puffy and dry under eye. I don’t even have sensitive skin. I stick to my Lancôme and Clinique eye cream. I definitely  need a seperate eye cream.
Definitely interested in this product for winter! Also looking at the cetaphil deep hydration one, looks like it has peptides too. I like the new water gel from that line a lot!

I love CeraVe products, too and use almost all their Renewing Line.  I really do love this eye cream a lot.  I just use it under my eyes and I am 68 and have noticed how much more it moisturizes than just using their Renewing Night Cream around my eyes.  This Renewing Eye Cream has such a nice texture and it does soften my fine lines nicely.  I will keep buying it and it is reasonable compared to the department store eye creams and this one is better and I love that all CeraVe is fragrance free.  Great video review and I’m glad you give it your approval:)
I'm a cerave Stan too.  It's just perfect for my skin. I really don't need any other products, just a cleanser, moisturizer, ointment as I have dry skin.  Now I'm loving cerave cleansing balm too
Ooh, this looks really good. Thanks for all of your great reviews!
